# showcase (cloudspider-showcase) v1.1.0

Demo prod cluster products (Online Boutique, Uptime Kuma, Wiki.js, Mealie) behind a shared ALB, a Boutique ALB and an NLB.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| clusterName | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | demo-prod | the EKS cluster it runs on |
| domain | must be a DNS name like demo.example.com | showcase.example.com | host rules on the shared ALB: kuma.<domain>, wiki.<domain>, mealie.<domain> |
| certificateArn | must be an ACM certificate ARN |  | HTTPS on both ALBs (HTTP redirects); none: HTTP only |
| wafAclArn | must be a regional WAFv2 web ACL ARN |  | WAF on both ALBs (about $5/month + $1/rule) |
| storageClass | must be a StorageClass name | showcase-gp3 | PVCs (Kuma, Mealie, Wiki.js DB); showcase-gp3 is made by this stack |

## Outputs

- `directLinks`
- `hosts`
- `sharedAlb`
- `boutiqueAlb`
- `tls`
- `BOUTIQUE_VERSION`
- `IMAGES`
- `BOUTIQUE`
- `PRODUCTS`
- `SHARED_GROUP`
- `NLB_SERVICE`
- `PRICES`
- `CANARY_SERVICE`

## Guarantees

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/aws` 7.50.0, `@pulumi/kubernetes` 4.34.2, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.

See CHANGELOG.md.
